content:
200 Returned if the list of scans running on the specified scanner was retrieved successfully.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The UUID of the scanner the scan belongs to.
string
The name of the scan.
string
The status of the scan. For a list of scan statuses and their
descriptions, see Scan Status.
string
The scan UUID.
integer
The ID of the scan.
string
The username of the owner of the scan.
integer
The last time the scan was modified.
integer
When the scan was started.
boolean
Indicates whether the scan is running remotely ('true') or not
('false').
string
The ID of the network object associated with the scanner
currently running the scan. The default network ID is
00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 . To determine
the ID of a custom network, use the GET /networks endpoint. For
more information about network objects, see Manage Networks.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to view scanner data.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified scanner.
